title: TSM Life Sciences Production Continuity: Governed Quality Intelligence
_note: Scripted scenario: engine outputs are canned via tests/e2e/helpers/stub-war-room.js, not live model output. Captions are DRAFTS. Narration lines are DRAFTS too: spoken text for --narrate, numbers written as words.

states.caption: Life Sciences Production Continuity war room
states.narration: This is the Life Sciences Production Continuity war room. A batch deviation starts here. What follows is a simulated incident.

states.caption: Batch deviation report loaded
states.narration: Particulate counts in fill-finish Suite B ran above the alert limit for forty minutes during a batch. The operator loads the deviation report.

states.caption: Six engines complete: risk scored 73/100
states.narration: Six engines assess it. The batch is on hold, and two downstream batches slip by about a week. Exposure runs from one point five to three point two million dollars. The risk score is seventy-three out of one hundred.

states.caption: Operations Strategist receives the life-sciences relay
states.narration: The Operations Strategist receives the case in one click, and projects the exposure with action, and without it.

states.caption: Executive Portal with the life-sciences relay
states.narration: The Executive Portal shows the decision: hold the batch and open a formal deviation investigation within four hours, for twenty-five thousand dollars. The system recommends. The head of quality decides.
